articles.headline: Wales rugby great Leigh Halfpenny announces retirement
articles.description: Wales great Leigh Halfpenny will retire at the end of the season to bring down the curtain on a professional career spanning almost two decades.

articles.headline: RFU backs England head coach Steve Borthwick after review
articles.description: The RFU has backed England men's head coach Steve Borthwick after undertaking a "detailed and robust review" of their dismal Six Nations campaign.
